summary: @onereach/billing-shared preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is variable-name-obfuscated and constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<archive>.zip`, downloads the Bun runtime, unzips it, chmods the binary 0o755, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun_path, [<math_init.js>])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB opaque bundle starting with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a string-array rotation function and a multi-thousand-entry integer/char lookup table (canonical string-array-shuffle obfuscation). math_init.js is not referenced from the package's dist/ Node sources — it is reachable only via the preinstall Bun invocation, meaning its contents never appear in the Node module graph and are executed exclusively by the freshly-dropped alternate runtime. The advertised purpose of the package is CSV/enum billing helpers, which has no need for a bundled Bun runtime or a 727KB opaque payload. The combination of an install-time alternate-runtime drop, wrapper obfuscation, and an opaque obfuscated payload executed under that dropped runtime is a supply-chain dropper: `npm install` of this version runs attacker-supplied, intentionally hidden code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
